activity.notes: Alfredo Stroessner served as President of Paraguay from 15 August 1954 until his overthrow on 3 February 1989. His repeated elections occurred under an authoritarian military-party regime; ATLAS records the continuous head-of-state tenure without treating each controlled electoral cycle as a separate Activity.

sources.title: Presidencia del General Alfredo Stroessner — Portal Guaraní
sources.citation_text: The Paraguayan historical portal gives Stroessner's presidency as 15 August 1954 to 3 February 1989.
